fichas.title: Squash courts
fichas.summary: Squash courts are described as having massive walls with special plastered surfaces, precast concrete elements, prefabricated panelled timber-framed roofs and potentially collapsible seating. A glass back wall is advantageous for spectators. The floor should be slightly springy, light-coloured wood with good slip resistance; floorboards run parallel to the side walls. Walls are flat white special plaster, with a metal or metal-clad strip (the tin) at the foot of the front wall.
